title: Free-Throw Pressure Pairs
description: Pairs must both make their free throws in the same round; a miss by either means both run a short sprint — building composure when a teammate depends on you.

content.objective: Make free throws under shared pressure, keeping the same routine regardless of the stakes.
content.setup: Pairs at each basket; one shooter at the line, partner rebounding.
content.organization: Each player shoots two; then swap.
instructions: Player A shoots two free throws using a consistent routine.
Player B shoots two free throws.
If the pair makes all four, they score a point.
If the pair misses two or more, both sprint baseline to free-throw line and back.
coachingPoints: Same routine every time: dribbles, breath, shot.
Focus on the rim, not the consequence.
Encourage your partner after a miss.
commonMistakes: Rushing the second shot after a miss.
content.safety: Sprints are short; water available; stop if anyone feels unwell.
regressions: No sprint penalty; just count points.
variations: Groups of four instead of pairs.
successCriteria: Pair reaches five points within the time.
Routine kept identical on every attempt.
content.gameApplication: Late-game free throws happen under pressure; practising them with consequences builds composure.
